Drug-related deaths in Milwaukee County

Source: R/data-milwaukee.R
milwaukee.Rd

A spatial point dataset of drug-related deaths recorded in Milwaukee County, Wisconsin, from 2020 onwards. Each row represents one event classified as "Drug Related" in the source records. Events have non-missing geocoded locations and intersect the Milwaukee County boundary supplied in milwaukee_county.

Format

An object of class sf with one row per event and the following variables:

event_id

Integer. Sequential identifier created for this packaged dataset. It does not correspond to the source record identifier.

DeathDate

Date. Recorded date of death.

death_year

Integer. Calendar year of DeathDate.

death_month

Date. First day of the calendar month containing DeathDate.

death_week

Date. Monday of the calendar week containing DeathDate.

death_day_of_week

Ordered factor. Day of the week, ordered Monday through Sunday.

death_weekend

Logical. Whether DeathDate falls on Saturday or Sunday.

geometry

An sf POINT geometry column in EPSG:26916.

Source

Original records: Milwaukee County Medical Examiner.

Processed records and geocoded locations: the Medical Examiner OpenData Pipeline. The packaged dataset was constructed from the data release dated 2025-12-01.

Spatial boundary used to select events: U.S. Census Bureau county cartographic boundary data, 2024, accessed through tigris; see milwaukee_county.

Details

The data are represented as an sf object with POINT geometry in NAD83 / UTM zone 16N (EPSG:26916). Coordinates are measured in metres and are therefore suitable for the spatial distance arguments used by fit_semihawkes.

The data were derived from Milwaukee County Medical Examiner records and geocoded locations distributed through the UK-IPOP Open Data Pipeline. The distributed version was constructed from the release dated 2025-12-01.

Construction retained records with DeathType == "Drug Related", DeathDate >= "2020-01-01", and non-missing geocoded longitude and latitude. Source coordinates were interpreted in WGS84 (EPSG:4326), then transformed to NAD83 / UTM zone 16N (EPSG:26916). Points were retained when they intersected the 2024 TIGER/Line boundary for Milwaukee County.

The dataset is provided for illustration, testing, and reproducible examples. It is not an authoritative administrative release. Event classifications, dates, and locations may contain errors or change in later releases of the source data. The data should not be used to make causal or policy claims.

The code used to construct the dataset is data-raw/make-milwaukee-data.R in the package's GitHub repository, https://github.com/HenriquesCadbyLab/spHawkes.

References

Anthony, N. (2022). Medical Examiner OpenData Pipeline (Version 0.2.1) [Computer software]. https://github.com/UK-IPOP/open-data-pipeline.

See also

milwaukee_county, fit_semihawkes

Examples

data("milwaukee")
data("milwaukee_county")

sf::st_crs(milwaukee)$epsg
#> [1] 26916
sf::st_geometry_type(milwaukee, by_geometry = TRUE)
